Codex entry title for the first Malison.

trans-unit.source: The first Hour, sung in the dark before dawn. It roots as a shrouded mass of living ink that drifts beneath the skin and tears what it passes. The shroud parts on a rhythm: only then will the brand bite. Wounded, it quickens and sheds shards that crawl for open wounds; at the last it burns away to a single eye that must be struck on the third beat of its pulse.
trans-unit.note: Codex entry body for the Malison of Matins.

trans-unit.source: Not a stroke wasted, Doctor. The page-boy will wake to morning bells and never know what sang in him.
trans-unit.note: Ilse's debrief after Matins at rank XS or S.

trans-unit.source: It’s out of him, and he’s breathing. We’ll learn its rhythm better next time — there will be a next time.
trans-unit.note: Ilse's debrief after Matins at rank A or B.

trans-unit.source: He lives. Barely, and scarred. Sit down before you fall, Doctor — then tell me what that thing was.
trans-unit.note: Ilse's debrief after Matins at rank C.
Codex entry title for the second Malison.

trans-unit.source: The dawn Hour, a curse that sings in parts. Its heart hides behind a ring of Voices, each silenced only by tracing its sigil. Wounded, it splits into two bodies joined by a thread of light that answer one another: strike one and the other must be struck before it sings the wound closed. At dawn it dives beneath the skin, surfacing only where the Lens finds its ripples between flares of blinding light.
trans-unit.note: Codex entry body for the Malison of Lauds.

trans-unit.source: You answered every verse before it could. Jorg will carry his banner again — and he’ll never hear that hymn.
trans-unit.note: Ilse's debrief after Lauds at rank XS or S.

trans-unit.source: The choir is silent. He’ll mend, slowly. That light at the end — I still see it when I close my eyes.
trans-unit.note: Ilse's debrief after Lauds at rank A or B.

trans-unit.source: We lost too much blood to that song. He’s alive, Doctor. Let that be enough tonight.
trans-unit.note: Ilse's debrief after Lauds at rank C.

trans-unit.source: Prime — The Roll of the Dead
trans-unit.note: Codex entry title for the third Malison.

trans-unit.source: The first hour of the working day, when the roll of the dead is read. A quill-like mass that writes names into its host stroke by stroke; a finished name takes its toll in blood. Strike the strokes out newest first with the lancet, and the quill hesitates long enough to be branded. Its spilt ink fouls any instrument it touches and, left too long, begins to write on its own.
trans-unit.note: Codex entry body for the Malison of Prime.

trans-unit.source: Not one name took. Whoever those people were, their names are their own again.
trans-unit.note: Ilse's debrief after Prime at rank XS or S.

trans-unit.source: Some of the ink dried before we reached it. He’ll carry a few names on his skin. We’ll pray over them.
trans-unit.note: Ilse's debrief after Prime at rank A or B.

trans-unit.source: It wrote your name, Doctor. I saw it. Promise me you’ll sleep with a candle lit tonight.
trans-unit.note: Ilse's debrief after Prime at rank C.
Codex entry title for the fourth Malison.

trans-unit.source: The third hour, when fire came down as tongues. A hexfire core hidden in one organ that leaps along the body’s paths; the brand only feeds it. Salve the flame-front and excise the ember beneath. Divided into three tongues it must be doused all at once, and at the last its heat-haze throws the instruments off true until the smoke is drawn away.
trans-unit.note: Codex entry body for the Malison of Terce.

trans-unit.source: Not a blister left where the fire walked. The guild will want to know how. Tell them nothing.
trans-unit.note: Ilse's debrief after Terce at rank XS or S.

trans-unit.source: The burns will heal. It smells of a burnt chapel in here — open the shutters, would you?
trans-unit.note: Ilse's debrief after Terce at rank A or B.

trans-unit.source: We fed it more than we should have. He’ll live, but the scars will speak for years.
trans-unit.note: Ilse's debrief after Terce at rank C.
Codex entry title for the fifth Malison.

trans-unit.source: The noon hour, the hour of listlessness. It lies beneath a stone crust and steeps the surgeon in torpor: the hand moves, the instrument answers late. It lies about the patient’s vitals — only the Lens on the heart tells the truth — and at its height it casts a stillness of its own that only broken sun-dials will end.
trans-unit.note: Codex entry body for the Malison of Sext.

trans-unit.source: You never let it slow your hand. I felt drowsy just watching — how did you stay so sharp?
trans-unit.note: Ilse's debrief after Sext at rank XS or S.

trans-unit.source: It lied to us about his heart, and still we caught it. Drink something cold, Doctor.
trans-unit.note: Ilse's debrief after Sext at rank A or B.

trans-unit.source: For a while I thought we’d both lie down beside him. Never again at noon, I swear it.
trans-unit.note: Ilse's debrief after Sext at rank C.
Codex entry title for the sixth Malison.

trans-unit.source: The ninth hour, the hour the heart stops. A burrower that tunnels toward the heart along hidden paths; if it arrives, the patient is lost. The Lens tracks its head, the lancet intercepts it, the brand splits it — and every split piece races on alone. At the last it is small enough to be pulled out whole, if the tongs are quick.
trans-unit.note: Codex entry body for the Malison of None.

trans-unit.source: It never came near his heart. Not once. I’ll light a candle for Pieter tonight — and one for you.
trans-unit.note: Ilse's debrief after None at rank XS or S.

trans-unit.source: Too close, Doctor. Too close. But his heart is still his own.
trans-unit.note: Ilse's debrief after None at rank A or B.

trans-unit.source: I heard the bell ring three and thought we’d lost him. We didn’t. Remember that.
trans-unit.note: Ilse's debrief after None at rank C.
Codex entry title for the seventh Malison.

trans-unit.source: The evening hour, when the lamps are lit. Wick-filaments threaded through the vessels turn blood to tallow, and four lamps of its own light the field. Keep them lit with the brand, or the dark quadrants hide it; it can be struck only while silhouetted against a lamp. At the last one lamp wanders, and the wick must be traced back to its root.
trans-unit.note: Codex entry body for the Malison of Vespers.

trans-unit.source: Every lamp kept burning. It’s darker in the street than in this room now.
trans-unit.note: Ilse's debrief after Vespers at rank XS or S.

trans-unit.source: There’s tallow in his veins still — it will thin. The lamps did their work, and so did you.
trans-unit.note: Ilse's debrief after Vespers at rank A or B.

trans-unit.source: We worked half of that in the dark. He’s alive. I won’t ask how.
trans-unit.note: Ilse's debrief after Vespers at rank C.
Codex entry title for the eighth Malison.

trans-unit.source: The last hour before sleep. It offers the patient a quiet night and a perfect end, drifting the vitals gently toward nothing. It wears the earlier Hours in turn, steals the Litany and turns it on the surgeon, and silences every sound. Break its silence-nodes to take the Litany back; at the last it yields only to the lancet and the brand in one breath.
trans-unit.note: Codex entry body for the Malison of Compline.

trans-unit.source: It sang him a lullaby and you refused it every verse. I have never been so glad of noise.
trans-unit.note: Ilse's debrief after Compline at rank XS or S.

trans-unit.source: For a moment it was so quiet I thought it was over. It was — just not the way it wanted.
trans-unit.note: Ilse's debrief after Compline at rank A or B.

trans-unit.source: He almost went so peacefully. That is the cruellest thing I’ve seen, Doctor.
trans-unit.note: Ilse's debrief after Compline at rank C.
Codex entry title for the final Malison.

trans-unit.source: The complete Hours, woven into one curse by the Hollow Choir: a clock-face of eight hour-sigils around a heart. Each lit sigil demands that Hour’s counter; then two Hours at once; and at the last the Choir’s own conductor-sigil, traced whole while Ilse holds the patient’s life with her prayer.
trans-unit.note: Codex entry body for the Office.

trans-unit.source: Every Hour, unsung. Kessendorf will wake tomorrow and never know how close it came. I will.
trans-unit.note: Ilse's ending debrief after the Office at rank XS or S.

trans-unit.source: It’s over. The Choir’s song is broken. Let’s go outside, Doctor — I want to hear the bells.
trans-unit.note: Ilse's ending debrief after the Office at rank A or B.

trans-unit.source: We are both still standing, and so is the city. Whatever it cost, it’s paid.
trans-unit.note: Ilse's ending debrief after the Office at rank C.

trans-unit.source: Every Hour, unsung — and the Inquisitor’s brand beside your own. Stroh will have to find someone else to burn.
trans-unit.note: Ilse's ending debrief after the Office at rank XS or S when Inquisitor Stroh is an ally.

trans-unit.source: It’s over. Stroh saw what the Litany is and still struck with us. That’s a kind of absolution.
trans-unit.note: Ilse's ending debrief after the Office at rank A or B when Stroh is an ally.

trans-unit.source: We barely held it, even with Stroh’s brand. But we held it. The city stands.
trans-unit.note: Ilse's ending debrief after the Office at rank C when Stroh is an ally.

trans-unit.source: A cut through the skin. It bleeds until closed. Zig-zag the Gut Thread across it, moving along the wound; small nicks take Saint’s Salve instead.
trans-unit.note: Surgeon’s Manual text: how to treat laceration.
Surgeon’s Manual page title for the ailment “Pooled Blood”.

trans-unit.source: Blood gathering in the field. It drains the patient and hides what lies beneath. Hold the Leech-Pipe over it until it is drawn off.
trans-unit.note: Surgeon’s Manual text: how to treat pooled blood.
Surgeon’s Manual page title for the ailment “Incision”.

trans-unit.source: The inked line you must open. Start at the glowing end and keep the Lancet to the line in one steady stroke.
trans-unit.note: Surgeon’s Manual text: how to treat incision.
Surgeon’s Manual page title for the ailment “Embedded Object”.

trans-unit.source: Arrows, bolts, shot and shards. Seize with the Tongs and pull along the shaft’s own line, clear off the body. Barbed heads need two Lancet nicks first.
trans-unit.note: Surgeon’s Manual text: how to treat embedded object.
Surgeon’s Manual page title for the ailment “Burn”.

trans-unit.source: Charred flesh. Pluck the black eschar away with the Tongs, then brush Saint’s Salve over the raw skin beneath.
trans-unit.note: Surgeon’s Manual text: how to treat burn.
Surgeon’s Manual page title for the ailment “Bubo”.

trans-unit.source: A swelling of plague pus. Lance it with one touch of the Lancet before it bursts, draw off the pus, and salve the wound.
trans-unit.note: Surgeon’s Manual text: how to treat bubo.
Surgeon’s Manual page title for the ailment “Rot”.

trans-unit.source: Spoiling flesh that creeps outward. Brush Saint’s Salve over nearly all of it — any island left grows back.
trans-unit.note: Surgeon’s Manual text: how to treat rot.
Surgeon’s Manual page title for the ailment “Venom”.

trans-unit.source: Poison running for the heart along the veins. Hold the Tincture on the bite until it takes; a stitch across the vein ties it off.
trans-unit.note: Surgeon’s Manual text: how to treat venom.
Surgeon’s Manual page title for the ailment “Grub”.

trans-unit.source: A burrowing maggot that feeds on open wounds. Hold the Cautery Brand on it until it stops moving.
trans-unit.note: Surgeon’s Manual text: how to treat grub.
Surgeon’s Manual page title for the ailment “Curse-Sigil”.

trans-unit.source: A hex burned into the skin, stroke by stroke. Hold the Cautery Brand on node one, then trace each stroke in order to sear it out.
trans-unit.note: Surgeon’s Manual text: how to treat curse-sigil.
